title: One Piece
author: Eiichiro Oda
description: Monkey D. Luffy and his pirate crew set sail in search of the legendary One Piece. A globe-spanning adventure about freedom, friendship, and impossible dreams.

title: Naruto
author: Masashi Kishimoto
description: A young ninja with a powerful secret dreams of becoming the leader of his village. Rivalries, friendships, and a much bigger world lie ahead.

title: Death Note
author: Tsugumi Ohba · Takeshi Obata
description: A student discovers a notebook with a terrifying power. A battle of intelligence follows as a mysterious detective closes in.

title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba
author: Koyoharu Gotouge
description: Tanjiro becomes a demon slayer in search of a way to save his sister. A story of family, perseverance, and humanity amid darkness.

title: Spy × Family
author: Tatsuya Endo
description: A spy, an assassin, and a telepath build a pretend family. Keeping their secrets turns out to be the most unpredictable mission of all.

title: Jujutsu Kaisen
author: Gege Akutami
description: Yuji Itadori steps into a hidden world of curses and sorcerers. Extraordinary friendships and dangerous choices reshape his ordinary life.

title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood
author: Bones
description: Two brothers search for the Philosopher’s Stone after an alchemical experiment costs them dearly. Their journey uncovers a conspiracy far beyond their hometown.

title: Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End
author: Madhouse
description: Decades after defeating the Demon King, an elven mage retraces a journey with new companions and learns what the passage of time means to the people she loves.

title: Attack on Titan
author: Wit Studio
description: Humanity lives behind towering walls. When those walls fall, three friends are swept into a struggle that challenges everything they know about their world.
